text: # Pharmacy Refund Policy Prescription medications cannot be returned or refunded once dispensed, in line with standard pharmacy safety regulations, unless the medication was dispensed in error by pharmacy staff. Over-the-counter medications may be refunded within 14 days of purchase if unopened and accompanied by a receipt. Refund requests for dispensing errors should be directed to the pharmacy admin, who will verify the error against the dispensing record before processing a refund or replacement.
